title: One in Three
sentences: Think of every third person you know.
That's roughly what the Black Death did to Europe.
Between 1347 and 1351, it killed somewhere between a third and a half of the population.
Some villages were emptied and never came back.
It took Europe around two hundred years to regrow its population.
Follow for more from the Black Death.
caption:
Think of every third person you know. Now imagine them gone.
